headline: PINBALL dresses up: two art kits, picked right on the row
lede: Never-dry found PINBALL the weakest game on the shelf, and the oldest actionable gap was a dressing-room one: the arcades sold art kits — the same machine in a new paint job — and our cabinets had no user-selectable look. Now they do: B (or Shift, or ▲▼) cycles TIDAL RUN on CABINET ONE and TOXIC on EMBER RIDER right in the attract row, ?style=<kit> finally works, and the dress survives quick-retry. Palette only — not one line of physics moved.

notes.text: #3259 shipped: SKINS registry in art.js (dress-only kits, key-parity enforced), B/▲▼ cycle on the row with marquee + KIT badge, ?style id-or-label preselect, KIT <NAME> on the DMD at launch. Gap-skip was honest: the editor gap stays deferred because #3103 says verbatim "Not yet".

pinballcheck 160/160 with a 6th mutant: renaming one baked key in TOXIC goes red — a kit that cannot paint every key cannot ship. pinballplay 42/42 live, pixels prove the repaint (green +20 / red −11 on the card).
One pre-existing race hardened: KICKBACK! +100 can be overwritten by a LANE SWEEP before the DMD read — announce checks now capture the message during polling instead of trusting the last frame.

stateHash/`cab` lesson: during attract, gs.table.id still names the last run, not the row's selection — the harness must read selection state, not sim lag. A numeric cab override silently broke two string-comparing legs; additive keys only.
